newsitem.title: UK: RODAMCO IN TALKS TO BUY UK'S IMRY--PAPER.
newsitem.headline: RODAMCO IN TALKS TO BUY UK'S IMRY--PAPER.

text.p: Rodamco NV, the property arm of the Dutch Robeco Group of investment funds, is in talks to buy property development firm Imry Holdings from bank Barclays Plc, The Times said on Tuesday in its early Wednesday edition.
Rodamco is discussing an offer believed to be worth up to 450 million pounds ($721.5 million) for Imry, which was rescued by Barclays in the early 1990s property crash, the newspaper added.
Imry owns a shopping centre in Leicester, central England, and a big retail development site in Southampton, in the south of the country.
Negotiations between Rodamco and Barclays are likely to be protracted and will focus on the costs of building the Southampton centre, The Times said.
Barclays acquired control of Imry in 1992 after funding a 314 million pound buyout of the property group, it added.
